findings.body:
Standard: AGENTS.md#Rule 2: Database Compatibility — PostgreSQL >= 9.6 (preferred), SQLite(sometimes used for local dev), MySQL (barely used)
Note: The claim path unconditionally emits a row lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE). AGENTS.md Rule 2 requires that SQLite/MySQL are not deliberately broken and that PG-only capabilities are either branched on common.UsingPostgreSQL/common.UsingSQLite or documented as PG-only in the feature spec; no feature-spec note is present here, so the SQLite local-dev path this repo supports would fail on this statement.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with AGENTS.md#Rule 2: Database Compatibility — PostgreSQL >= 9.6 (preferred), SQLite(sometimes used for local dev), MySQL (barely used).

Dependency additions in go.mod/go.sum (larksuite/oapi-sdk-go/v3 plus indirect gogo/protobuf and older golang.org/x entries) are traceable to the stated SDK adoption and are not scope creep.
The new tables' AutoMigrate registration in model/main.go and the main.go wiring are both explicitly listed in the body; nothing substantial in the diff falls outside the stated intent.
